name: Selim II
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1566 to 1574
contribution: The Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1566 until his death in 1574.
legacy: The conquest of Cyprus and Tunis were notable achievements, though the Ottoman navy was defeated at the battle of Lepanto.

checks.lead: Selim II (Ottoman Turkish: سليم ثانى, romanized: Selīm-i sānī; Turkish: II. Selim; 28 May 1524 – 15 December 1574), also known as Selim the Blond (Turkish: Sarı Selim) or Selim the Drunkard (Sarhoş Selim), was the Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1566 until his death in 1574.
